text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 10, 2025) for 299 Forman Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Confirmed Item 1 of the Property Standards Order (July 10, 2025) for 299 Forman Avenue, Folder Number 25 191032 PRS 00 IV. 2. Confirmed Items 2 and 3 of the Property Standards Order (July 10, 2025) for 299 Forman Avenue, Folder Number 25 191032 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to January 30, 2026, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
